title: SDK flow client is the scanned project's package name
description: flow-interaction-description.ts prefers package_name, which is the scanned project's own name, so SDK flows get client = repo name. Use the SDK or vendor package. Also stop hard-coding internal fetches and the engineering.protocol fallback as rest (DATAP-937).

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Merged with PR 122: SDK findings carry sdkPackage (imported module); client uses it, never package_name. Internal fetch: protocol unknown unless GraphQL, client fetch. engineering.protocol no longer falls back to inferred rest.
